title: BBL Dimensional Resources
description: Obtaining Resources from other planets using a Interdimensional Laser
body:
# __**Dimensional Resources**__

## **__Overview__**

Dimensional Resources is a brand new mod for 26.1.2 that allows you to fire a laser at distant planets to mine resources from them 

## **__Interdimensional Laser__**
Firstly in the world you will find a new ore called Dimensional Ore, this is found very low in the world between -16 and -64. Mining this ore will give you Dimensional Shards, a core ingredient for the mod. Next you will need to craft yourself a Spyglass and a Planet Locator.Whilst holding a Planet Locator in your offhand and using a Spyglass look into the sky to find planets!. After discovering a Planet the Planet Locator will be set to that Planet

Happy Mining 

## __**Support**__
